LSMU School, Montgomery Bell Academy (MBA) ir Harpeth Hall (HH): We Are Family

Since now June 13 will be known to the LSMU School community as a very special day. On this day students and teachers from the LSMU school went to Vilnius to greet and meet a sixteen-people delegation from two American schools (the Montgomery Bell Academy) and the Harpeth Hall School) and to bring them back to Kaunas.
